listing.jobDescription:
General Description: 

The DMPK Department of BeOne Medicines is seeking a highly motivated individual to join the PK/PD modeling & simulation (M&S) group. The successful candidate will have strong background and expertise in PK/PD and ADME concept, and have hands-on experience on PK/PD M&S. The individual in this position will support pre-clinical project teams as a M&S expert, and provide PK/PD data analysis and M&S support to enable critical decision making. 

Education Required:  
A Ph.D. degree in pharmacokinetics, pharmacology, or pharmaceutical Sciences with hands-on experience on PK/PD modeling is required

Essential Functions of the job: 
•	Conduct QSP, mechanistic or semi-mechanistic PKPD modeling to understand the mechanism of action, facilitate molecular design and hypothesis testing, as well as build the correlation between PK and PD/efficacy 
•	Predict maximum absorbable dose (MAD), human PK, and DDI with PBPK modeling
•	Explore drug ADME mechanistically with PBPK modeling
•	Apply PKPD modeling and PBPK modeling into human efficacious dose prediction
•	Collaborate with clinical pharmacology to provide a rationale for dose escalation and dose range in phase 1 studies
•	Evaluate novel in silico tools and methodology to improve human PK and dose prediction
•	Provide DMPK and PK/PD expertise and input into related documents such as Investigator Brochures, SOPs, study reports, manuscripts, summaries for regulatory authorities, INDs, NDAs and sNDAs
•	Other duties as assigned
listing.title: 研究员，药代/药效建模/Research Investigator，PK/PD modeler(博士)
